---
title: "Alpha_Analysis_PD"
output: html_document
---

```{r libraries, include=FALSE}

# Loading Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggpubr)
library(microbiome)
library(indicspecies)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(indicspecies)
library(dplyr)

#### Loading and tidying data

# Loading and filtering metadata
metadata_unfiltered = read.delim('parkinsons_metadata.txt', row.names = 1) 

metadata <- metadata_unfiltered %>%
  filter(Disease == "PD")

# Loading taxonomy table
taxonomy = read.delim('taxonomy.tsv', row.names = 1)

# Loading feature table
counts = read.delim('feature-table.txt', skip=1, row.names=1)  

# Tidying taxonomy table
taxonomy_formatted = taxonomy %>%
  separate(col = Taxon,
           into = c('Domain', 'Phylum', 'Class', 'Order', 'Family', 'Genus', 'Species'),
           sep=';', fill = 'right') %>%
  select(-Confidence) %>%
  as.matrix()

counts_formatted = counts %>% as.matrix()

# Creating phyloseq object
ps = phyloseq(sample_data(metadata),
              otu_table(counts_formatted, taxa_are_rows = T),
              tax_table(taxonomy_formatted))

# Saving phyloseq object to be used in all downstream analyses
# Note -  phyloseq objects were generated for both alpha and beta diversity analyses
# This is the phyloseq object used in all downstream analyses  
saveRDS(ps, 'phyloseq_taxonomy.rds')

# Setting seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Rarefying based on depth from alpha rarefaction curve
psrare = ps %>% rarefy_even_depth(sample.size = 5103, rngseed = 123)

#### Shannon alpha diversity analysis
# Measuring Shannon alpha diversity based on farm-living status
shannon = plot_richness(psrare, x = 'Lived_on_farm', measures = c('Shannon'))

# Plotting Shannon alpha diversity (basic plot)
p = plot_richness(psrare, x = 'Lived_on_farm', 
                  measures = c('Shannon'),
                  color = 'Lived_on_farm',
                  theme(plot.title = element_blank()))


# Adding the p-values from the Shannon alpha diversity analysis to the data 
pdata = p$data


# Generating formatted alpha diversity plot
p_formatted = pdata %>% ggplot(aes(Lived_on_farm,value,fill = Lived_on_farm)) +
 geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.5)+
    theme_classic(base_size=6) +
  facet_wrap(~variable,ncol=4,scales = 'free_y') +
 
  labs(
    x = "Lived on Farm",
    y = "Shannon Alpha Diversity",
    fill = "Lived on Farm") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgrey", "steelblue"))+
  theme(
  plot.title = element_blank(),
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_blank()
)

# Adding statistical test to Shannon alpha diversity plot
comparisons <- list(c("Yes", "No"))

p_final <- p_formatted +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = comparisons, method = "wilcox.test", size = 6) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .1)))

p_final

# ggsave("alpha_plot.png", plot = p_final, width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
